scenarios.title: Hot key expiry
scenarios.description: A very popular entry expires and thousands of requests miss at once.
probes: How do you refresh without a stampede?

scenarios.title: Node loss
scenarios.description: A cache node fails and its keys miss.
probes: How do you recover capacity safely?

scenarios.title: Stale data
scenarios.description: An update races with a cache fill and leaves old data cached.
probes: How do you bound the damage?
